content:
The **Ultracite Terror** is a creature in Appalachia in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Gleaming Depths* update. It is the final boss of Raid: Gleaming Depths, in the location of the same name.

The Ultracite Terror was originally Butch, the pet venomous snake of Doctor Robert Gaines, the head of the Enclave's Project Vulcan. [1] It was subjected to experiments related to Ultragenesis and more generally with Ultracite in the Enclave's facility in the Gleaming Depths. During an experiment testing Ultragenesis by bombarding an Ultracite crystal with soundwaves, the snake became enraged and escaped its containment, brutally killing Dr. Gaines in the process. [citation needed] 

When the snake initially escaped containment, it was supposedly still of a manageable size. [1] It presumably mutated into its current massive size due to further prolonged exposure to Ultracite and radiation, as happened with other creatures such as the Ultracite Titan and the Scorchbeasts (the latter also created by Enclave experimentation).

A creature hundreds of meters long, the Ultracite Terror is the largest single organism ever featured in the *Fallout* series. Since being left to its own devices as the facility was first locked down and then abandoned, it has grown massively and taken on an appearance more resembling a cobra snake with its hood flaps. It has mutated two additional eyes, a multitude of new fangs, and spiky growths covering every section of its impossibly long body. 

The Ultracite Terror has two poison attacks, a spray attack that deals 22 ballistic and 22 poison damage and a heat seeking projectile attack that deals 233 ballistic and 233 poison damage. [2] 

The Ultracite Terror only spawns as the final boss of Raid: Gleaming Depths.

The Ultracite Terror appears only in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Gleaming Depths* update. It is also mentioned in *Fallout Shelter* by way of the Ultracite Terror sword.
